title: DPO 损失与梯度方向（含解析对照）
expected_output:
beta = 0.10
chosen  隐式奖励 = beta * (logp_pi - logp_ref) = 0.0300
rejected 隐式奖励 = -0.0400
奖励差 margin = 0.0700
DPO loss = -log(sigmoid(margin)) = 0.658760

d(loss)/d(logp_chosen)   = -0.048251
d(loss)/d(logp_rejected) = +0.048251
梯度方向符合预期(抬高 chosen / 压低 rejected): True

解析对照: d(loss)/d(margin) = -(1 - sigmoid(margin)) = -0.482507
          再乘 dmargin/dlogp_chosen = beta = 0.10, 得 -0.048251
code:
import math
logp_pi_c, logp_ref_c = -1.20, -1.50
logp_pi_r, logp_ref_r = -2.00, -1.60
beta = 0.10

def dpo_loss(lpc, lpr):
    margin = beta * ((lpc - logp_ref_c) - (lpr - logp_ref_r))
    return -math.log(1.0 / (1.0 + math.exp(-margin))), margin

loss, margin = dpo_loss(logp_pi_c, logp_pi_r)
print('beta = %.2f' % beta)
print('chosen  隐式奖励 = beta * (logp_pi - logp_ref) = %.4f' % (beta * (logp_pi_c - logp_ref_c)))
print('rejected 隐式奖励 = %.4f' % (beta * (logp_pi_r - logp_ref_r)))
print('奖励差 margin = %.4f' % margin)
print('DPO loss = -log(sigmoid(margin)) = %.6f' % loss)
print()
h = 1e-4
gp, _ = dpo_loss(logp_pi_c + h, logp_pi_r)
gm, _ = dpo_loss(logp_pi_c - h, logp_pi_r)
grad_c = (gp - gm) / (2 * h)
gp2, _ = dpo_loss(logp_pi_c, logp_pi_r + h)
gm2, _ = dpo_loss(logp_pi_c, logp_pi_r - h)
grad_r = (gp2 - gm2) / (2 * h)
print('d(loss)/d(logp_chosen)   = %+.6f' % grad_c)
print('d(loss)/d(logp_rejected) = %+.6f' % grad_r)
print('梯度方向符合预期(抬高 chosen / 压低 rejected):', bool(grad_c < 0 < grad_r))
print()
print('解析对照: d(loss)/d(margin) = -(1 - sigmoid(margin)) = %.6f' % (-(1 - 1 / (1 + math.exp(-margin)))))
print('          再乘 dmargin/dlogp_chosen = beta = %.2f, 得 %+.6f' % (beta, -(1 - 1 / (1 + math.exp(-margin))) * beta))
